== Editing the family navigator ==
This shared navigator appears in the Versions infobox of each article in the Reflections Gold [[Chewbacca]] family. To update membership, use the '''Edit versions''' link on a member article or edit this template's source. Each publication entry uses [[Template:Card version link]] with its canonical article title and concise visible label.

Add a verified publication here once and include <code><nowiki>{{Card versions/Chewbacca (Reflections Gold)}}</nowiki></code> in its card template's <code>versions</code> field. Keep its existing images, text and identity.

Independent family: same printed name as a Decipher expansion card, different picture (Bill 17 Nov 2026). Same rule as [[Boba Fett (Cloud City)]] vs [[Boba Fett (Special Edition)]]. Worked: [[Chewbacca (Reflections Gold)]] vs A New Hope [[Chewbacca]].
